* Provide feedback for product and service improvement.
* Maintain Signant Health’s scientific reputation in digital health and clinical trials.

* Advanced degree in medical research; **PhD preferred**.

* Business understanding and growth-focused thinking.

* Experience working across teams in a matrix environment.
* Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

* Experience in solution design and requirement gathering.
* Knowledge of ePRO or eCOA solution development for clinical trials.

* Clinical outcome assessments

A PhD is preferred, but candidates with strong medical research experience and dermatology exposure may also be considered depending on the company’s screening criteria.

The selected candidate will work on **AMPS recipes, Electronic Batch Records, SAP interface support, Bill of Material creation, production version readiness, Manufacturing Label Management, and shop floor troubleshooting**.

* Review protocols and documentation related to manufacturing systems.
* Initiate change controls related to documents and equipment.
* Identify deviations or exceptions and escalate them as per procedure.
* Follow safety procedures, GMP, and GDP practices.

## Quality and Compliance Responsibilities

In the Pfizer Associate MES job, compliance is a major part of the role. The candidate will be expected to:

* Ensure operations comply with **cGMP, safety, and Pfizer integrity principles**.
* Participate in internal, external, regulatory, and non-regulatory audits.
* Prepare procedures related to the work area as per regulatory requirements.
* Complete online documentation as per cGMP and GDP expectations.
* Submit documents to the documentation cell on time.
* Prepare daily activity reports.
* Ensure all activities are performed according to approved procedures.

## Training Responsibilities

The Associate MES will also support training activities, including:

* Attending all applicable procedural training as per schedule.
* Training team members on relevant procedures.
* Getting trained on assigned work areas.
* Providing AMPS, SAP, and MLM training to new hires.
* Conducting refresher training for end users.

## Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for the Pfizer Associate MES job should have:

* Diploma, graduate, or postgraduate qualification in **Pharmaceutical Science Discipline or Engineering**.
* 0-3+ years of experience in pharmaceutical dosage form manufacturing or manufacturing operations.
* Knowledge of Manufacturing Execution System is preferred.
* Understanding of EBR, SAP, AMPS, MLM, BOM, PV, GMP, and GDP will be useful.

## Who Can Apply?

This Pfizer MES job is suitable for candidates from:

* B.Pharm
* M.Pharm
* Diploma in Pharmacy or related technical discipline
* Pharmaceutical Science graduates
* Engineering graduates with manufacturing systems interest
* Candidates with pharmaceutical manufacturing operations experience
* Freshers or early-career candidates interested in MES and digital manufacturing

* Electronic Batch Record handling

* AMPS recipe creation and revision
* BOM and production version creation
* GMP and GDP documentation
* CAPA, change control, and deviation handling
* Shop floor troubleshooting

For an Associate MES role at Pfizer in Vizag, a realistic salary range may be around:

**₹3,50,000 to ₹7,50,000 per year**

The actual salary may vary based on education, experience, pharmaceutical manufacturing exposure, MES knowledge, SAP skills, and interview performance.

## Why This Role Is Important

The Pfizer Associate MES role connects pharmaceutical manufacturing with digital execution systems. MES, AMPS, EBR, SAP, and MLM systems help improve batch execution, documentation accuracy, compliance tracking, and manufacturing traceability.

For candidates who want to grow in **pharma manufacturing technology, quality systems, digital manufacturing, MES validation, and GMP operations**, this role can provide strong industry exposure.
